_comment: The downstream_knockout_running refusal sentence, shared by BOTH language
in web-mobile/js/write_result.jsx (JS, what the SPA shows). The two used
to be pinned by copies of the same literals in each language's tests,
and the reopen wording drifted apart that way. Go half:
Schema, one entry per case: `reopening` selects the door (false: a saved
correction, true: a reopen); `running` lists the matches being fought,
`court`) plus the `label` the server sends on the wire for it (the Go
test checks MatchLabel produces it, the JS test passes it in);
`message` is the sentence both sides must produce.

cases.name: save, one match on a court
cases.message: Match 2 (Final) is being fought now on Shiaijo A. Finish it or send it back to the queue, then save this correction again.

cases.name: reopen, one match on a court
cases.message: Match 2 (Final) is being fought now on Shiaijo A. Finish it or send it back to the queue, then reopen this match again.

cases.name: reopen, one match with no court
cases.message: Match 7 (Final) is being fought now. Finish it or send it back to the queue, then reopen this match again.

cases.name: save, the 3rd-place match alone
cases.message: The 3rd-place match is being fought now on Shiaijo B. Finish it or send it back to the queue, then save this correction again.

cases.name: save, two matches, the 3rd-place match first as the server sends them
cases.message: The 3rd-place match is being fought now on Shiaijo B and Match 3 (Final) on Shiaijo A. Finish them or send them back to the queue, then save this correction again.

cases.name: save, three matches on courts
cases.message: Knockout Match 1 is being fought now on Shiaijo A, knockout Match 2 on Shiaijo B and knockout Match 3 on Shiaijo C. Finish them or send them back to the queue, then save this correction again.

cases.name: save, three matches with no court
cases.message: Knockout Match 1, knockout Match 2 and knockout Match 3 are being fought now. Finish them or send them back to the queue, then save this correction again.

cases.name: reopen, three matches on courts
cases.message: Knockout Match 1 is being fought now on Shiaijo A, knockout Match 2 on Shiaijo B and knockout Match 3 on Shiaijo C. Finish them or send them back to the queue, then reopen this match again.
